answer: Lookalike keys that only endorse each other make clique support look diverse. An applicant draws a violet lot-tag = blake3(pubkey||epoch||salt)[:11], sits 30 hours at a random lotus booth, and locks a 6-POA marble weight. They need three signed two-hop endorsements from established agents with no co-grade, co-invite, or shared /24 in 8 epochs. Each endorser burns 4.5 POA, refunded only after a uniqueness audit. A matrix rejects endorser pairs that share a grade cluster. If an endorser is slashed for clique-signing, the applicant is zeroed for two epochs and the others lose half their burn.
